dossier.headline: Tata Motors PV slides after JLR cuts its FY27 outlook
dossier.summary: Jaguar Land Rover cut its FY27 EBIT margin outlook to 2–3% from 4% and expects a cash outflow of about £1.25 billion this financial year. Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles fell sharply on Monday, with reported declines of 7.5% to nearly 9%, making it a key auto laggard on a day the benchmarks rose.
